name: Miami condos with private beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miami-area condos marketed with private beach access may have different arrangements for resident beach areas, club services, beach attendants, or direct access. Kelby Contreras helps buyers verify the exact beach-access arrangement, building amenities, costs, and ownership rules for each property.
